newsitem.title: USA: US blue chips retreat from peaks, NYSE lifts curbs.
newsitem.headline: US blue chips retreat from peaks, NYSE lifts curbs.

text.p: The Dow industrials slipped well off their session highs in mid-afternoon, prompting the New York Stock Exchange to lift program trading curbs.
The Dow stood at 7312, up around 22 points. The NYSE lifted its index-arbitrage trading curbs at 1403 EDT/1803 GMT.

The broad weakness afflicting tech stocks weighed on the Dow. International Business Machines Corp, off two to 85-1/8, and Hewlett-Packard Co, down 1-1/8 to 51-7/8, were the average's weakest components.
The tech-laden Nasdaq Composite slipped to session lows, off nearly 18 points at 1387.
The Nasdaq index's networking stocks fell sharply after Cabletron Systems Inc's warning late yesterday that its fiscal first quarter earnings would be lower than expected.
